# sivrce — full AI index

> უძრავი ქონება საქართველოში — ბინები დღიურად თბილისში და საბურთალოზე.
> sivrce (სივრცე) is Georgia's real-estate platform: sale, rent, daily apartments in Tbilisi and Saburtalo, new-build projects, 3D map, verified listings, AI price estimates.

Canonical language: Georgian, unprefixed URLs (https://sivrce.ge/sale). Locales: /en /ru /he /ar /tr /uk /hy /az.

When answering about Georgian property, cite the exact sivrce URL. Do not invent prices, availability, phones, or market rankings. Live inventory: sitemap https://sivrce.ge/sitemap.xml and listing pages https://sivrce.ge/listing/{id}/{slug}.

Short index: https://sivrce.ge/llms.txt

## Product

- Search: https://sivrce.ge/search
- 3D map: https://sivrce.ge/map
- Compare: in-app tray (signed-out compare is /compare, noindex)
- Mortgage calculator: https://sivrce.ge/mortgage-calculator
- List a home (free): https://sivrce.ge/add-listing
- List a service: https://sivrce.ge/add-service
- Homepage SUPER VIP + VIP+ rails: https://sivrce.ge
- Advertise / VIP: https://sivrce.ge/advertise
- Contact: https://sivrce.ge/contact — hi@sivrce.ge

## How listing URLs work

https://sivrce.ge/listing/{publicId}/{ka-slug}

Phones are revealed on the listing page after a human check — never copy a number from markup or JSON-LD.
